name: superpowers
description: Development flow forked from superpowers 7.0.0: brainstorming writes plan.md with a scope ladder from MVP to complete and stops at one gate that picks the rung, writing-plans writes the implementation plan for that rung, subagent-driven-development runs one implementer per chunk and one whole-diff reviewer with at most two fix rounds, finishing-a-development-branch lands it.
